changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Linked bounded controlled geometry output to the Step1X texture stage.
changes.details: Operator guidance names the exact next recipe and the existing 240 MiB downstream input limit without claiming unsupported composite orchestration.

changes.summary: Validated reachable finite nondegenerate label-controlled triangle geometry before atomically publishing each GLB.
Sent geometry_type to the label encoder and repaired its lookup so sharp control selects a different embedding than normal.
Postponed mesh annotations and made every pymeshlab use lazy so controlled geometry imports without its unavailable ARM64 wheel.
Pinned exact CUDA 13 CPython 3.12 ARM64 wheels for CuPy and fastrlock and added geometry and texture import smoke tests.
Declared exact one-image input and single-GLB output slots with bounded bytes.
Made the controlled label-geometry Candidate installable with a bounded signed image-to-GLB entrypoint while retaining physical Spark qualification as pending.
Pinned official Step1X source cb5ac944, PyTorch 2.13, CUDA 13.2, and SM121-native build authority.
Eliminated the implicit BRIA download, bound DINOv2 and CLIP processor authorities, and fixed the official symmetry and edge contract.
Marked the label-geometry binding non-executable pending Step1X source, label handling, native dependencies, and a GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image input contract.
Replaced the broken model-card license URL with the exact upstream Apache-2.0 license.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Step1X-3D label-geometry pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
